articles.headline: Morocco 'behind' captain Achraf Hakimi amid rape case
articles.description: Morocco coach Mohamed Ouahbi said the team are "behind" captain Achraf Hakimi and says the player is "very relaxed" after a French appeals court confirmed Friday Hakimi will stand trial in a rape case.
